content_sections.heading: About ESIC Faridabad
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad is a medical college and hospital of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India). It is located at NH 3, NIT, Faridabad-121001 (Haryana). The recruitment is issued under File No. 134-A-14/13/Roster/2016- Admin and signed by the Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, NH3, NIT-3, Faridabad. The letterhead gives phone number 129-2970111.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 52 vacancies: 7 for Professor, 21 for Associate Professor and 24 for Assistant Professor. The department-wise and category-wise break-up below is as printed. A "-" means the notice lists no vacancy for that post in that department. For posts marked *, an unreserved faculty member is currently working against the reserved category post. The interview for these posts will be held only if candidates of the respective reserved category appear. Of the 52 posts, 18 are marked *: 3 Professor, 9 Associate Professor and 6 Assistant Professor posts. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice gives one qualification rule for all three posts. It does not print a separate degree or experience requirement for each post. The notice does not mention post-wise experience separately. An experience certificate is one of the documents candidates must produce. The cut-off date for eligibility is the date of interview, 30 October 2026. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification and the NMC regulations it names. For all three posts, candidates must be not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (30 October 2026). Tenure runs till 70 years at most.

rows.qualification: As per the latest NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines. NMC Notification (30/06/2025) on "Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations 2025" will apply.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Contract period: 1 year (extendable up to 3 years), subject to approval and satisfactory performance. Service can be terminated at any time in public interest. Resignation requires one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu. No entitlement to service benefits (PF, pension, gratuity, etc.). Hostel/quarters subject to availability. Attendance is mandatory through the biometric system. No private practice is allowed. The security deposit is paid by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1", payable at Faridabad. It is refundable when the contract is completed and a No Dues Certificate is submitted. It is forfeited if the candidate resigns within six months (except under exceptional circumstances).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: ESIC Faridabad is recruiting through a walk-in interview with an offline application. The steps below follow the notice:

rows.category: SC/ST/ESIC Employees, Female Candidates, Ex-servicemen, PwD

rows.fee: ₹500 (Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1", payable at Faridabad)

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: 10th certificate (DOB proof) MBBS mark-sheets and degree MD/MS/DNB mark-sheets and degree Valid caste/EWS/PwD certificate (as applicable) Updated Medical Registration (State/NMC) Publications Experience certificate Passport-size photo NOC/relieving certificate (if applicable) Aadhaar card ICMR/NMC-approved Basic Course in Biomedical Research certificate (if any) NMC-approved Basic/Revised Basic Course in Medical Education certificate (if any) EWS and OBC certificates must be in the proper Government of India format.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic credentials and performance in the interview. Only candidates whose documents are verified will be interviewed. Results will be posted on www.esic.gov.in. The offer of appointment will be sent by email, and selected candidates will join as per the instructions in the appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: False information leads to cancellation. The Dean, ESIC MCH, Faridabad reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates should check the website regularly for updates. Contact for queries: [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 52 vacancies: 7 for Professor, 21 for Associate Professor and 24 for Assistant Professor, spread across 22 broad specialty departments.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ESIC Faridabad walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026 at the Examination Hall, Academic Block, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad. Candidates must report between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the ESIC Faridabad faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualification follows the latest NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines, and the NMC Notification (30/06/2025) on "Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations 2025" will apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview, 30 October 2026. Tenure runs till 70 years at most.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor at ESIC Faridabad?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is ₹2,63,070 per month for Professor, ₹1,74,936 per month for Associate Professor and ₹1,50,294 per month for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Nil for SC/ST/ESIC Employees, Female Candidates, Ex-servicemen and PwD candidates. Others pay ₹500 by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1", payable at Faridabad.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the offline application form attached with the advertisement and add self-attested copies of your documents. Then attend the walk-in interview on 30 October 2026, reporting between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Use a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic credentials and interview performance, and only verified candidates are allowed into the interview. Results will be posted on www.esic.gov.in, and the offer of appointment will be sent by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ESIC Faridabad faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract for an initial 1 year, extendable up to 3 years, and come with no entitlement to PF, pension or gratuity. Service can be terminated at any time in public interest.

faq.question: Q10. Is a security deposit required after selection?
faq.answer: Yes. Each post requires a security deposit of ₹20,000 by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1", payable at Faridabad. It is refunded when the contract ends and a No Dues Certificate is submitted, and it is forfeited if the candidate resigns within six months (except under exceptional circumstances).
